name: fuel-manager
description: FuelManager - Système de gestion d'une société de carburant (Angular + PostgreSQL) - ISET Charguia

scripts.seed: node -e "import { initPostgres, seedPostgres, pool } from './server/db.js'; await initPostgres(); const client = await pool.connect(); await seedPostgres(client); client.release(); console.log('PostgreSQL reseeded!'); process.exit(0);"

author: Noussair Huimli, Rayen Bakey, Koussay Ghriss (ISET Charguia)
